problem: The caption says the edge node at 5 ms is the only tier that fits a 50 ms budget with 20 ms of compute. The regional fog node at 25 ms round trip also fits: 25 + 20 = 45 ms, which is under 50 ms. Only the cloud (60 + 20 = 80 ms) and the camera itself (90 ms) fail. A student reading the caption and then applying T_total = T_net + T_comp will get a contradiction.
fix: With 20 ms of compute, the edge node gives 25 ms and the fog node gives 45 ms, so both fit the 50 ms budget; the cloud data centre gives 80 ms and does not. Caption: 'the edge node at 5 ms and the regional fog node at 25 ms both fit a 50 ms budget once 20 ms of compute is added (25 ms and 45 ms); the cloud at 80 ms does not.'

problem: 'Both trade the cloud's unlimited capacity for milliseconds and saved bandwidth' is compressed to the point of confusion; 'milliseconds' is not a thing you get in exchange.
fix: Both give up some of the cloud's capacity in return for lower delay and less bandwidth used.

problem: 'An offload saves the phone 40% of its battery' reads as 40% of the whole battery charge, which is not what a single offload can do.
fix: An offload saves 40% of the energy that this task would otherwise use on the phone.

problem: 'The cloud does not disappear; it moves further from the sensor and closer to the archive' is unclear — the cloud is not moving anywhere; its role shifts to later stages.
fix: The cloud does not disappear. Its role shifts to the later stages — collecting logs, retraining the model, keeping archives — while the first stage of the job runs on the edge.
